description: Telcoin node metrics. The Prometheus of the observability compose profile scrapes every validator (job telcoin-node) and node_exporter (job node). Every query is scoped by the job and instance variables; host panels use node_job and node_instance.

panels.title: Canonical Height
panels.description: Latest canonical block height produced by the engine.

panels.title: Node Mode
panels.description: One-hot node mode: cvv_active / cvv_inactive / observer.

panels.title: Consensus Sync Distance
panels.description: Gossip consensus height minus locally executed height. Persistently growing = falling behind.

panels.title: Queued Consensus Outputs
panels.description: Backlog of consensus outputs awaiting execution. Growth means execution is falling behind consensus.

panels.title: Current Epoch
panels.description: Epoch number the node is in now.

panels.title: Time to Epoch Boundary
panels.description: Seconds until the current epoch ends. Negative when the boundary timestamp is in the past.

panels.title: Epoch Runs by Mode (1h)
panels.description: run_epoch iterations per hour by mode. new_epoch faster than the epoch cadence or any mode_change = recovery/flapping.

panels.title: Rounds
panels.description: Current primary round and the last committed round. A growing gap means consensus proposes but does not commit.

panels.title: Headers Proposed /s
panels.description: Rate of headers the primary proposed.

panels.title: Certificates /s
panels.description: Rate of certificates the primary formed from votes.

panels.title: Commit Latency p95
panels.description: Leader header creation to subdag commit. Second granularity - flags pathological commits.

panels.title: Subdag Commits /s
panels.description: Rate of subdag commits in the primary.

panels.title: Pending & Fetched Certificates
panels.description: Certificates that wait for their parents, and certificates fetched from peers.

panels.title: Blocks Executed /s
panels.description: Rate of blocks the engine executed.

panels.title: Execution Duration
panels.description: Block execution duration quantiles from the engine histogram.

panels.title: Block Gas Used
panels.description: Distribution of gas used per block.

panels.title: Transactions /s (TPS)
panels.description: Rate of transactions the executor output.

panels.title: Outputs: Ready vs Executed /s
panels.description: Rate of consensus outputs that became ready versus outputs the executor finished.

panels.title: Batch Fetch for Execution
panels.description: Rate of batch fetch failures during execution.

panels.title: Connected Peers
panels.description: Peers with an open connection, per network (primary or worker).

panels.title: Connection Churn /s
panels.description: Rate of connections established and closed, per network.

panels.title: Gossip /s
panels.description: Rate of gossip messages received, per network.

panels.title: Outbound Request Failures /s
panels.description: Rate of outbound requests that failed, per network.

panels.title: In-flight Requests
panels.description: Outbound requests that wait for a response, per network.

panels.title: Kad Records & External Addr
panels.description: Kademlia records the node holds and the count of confirmed external addresses, per network.

panels.title: Pending Pool Transactions
panels.description: Transactions that wait in the batch builder pool.

panels.title: Base Fee
panels.description: Base fee the batch builder uses for the next batch.

panels.title: Batches Sealed /s
panels.description: Rate of batches the worker sealed.

panels.title: Batch Size & Transactions p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of batch size in bytes and of transactions per batch.

panels.title: Quorum Wait p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time a worker waits for a batch quorum.

panels.title: Batch Fetch Local-hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of batches fetched from the local store instead of from a peer (the bounded source label).

panels.title: Quorum Failures by Reason /s
panels.description: Batches this node proposed that peers rejected, timed out, or failed quorum.

panels.title: Invalid Votes & Vote Failures /s
panels.description: Rate of invalid votes and vote failures seen by the primary.

panels.title: Validation Failures & Protocol Violations /s
panels.description: Rate of batch validation failures and protocol violations.

panels.title: Gossip Rejected /s
panels.description: Gossip that failed verification against authorized publishers - results in a fatal penalty for the propagation source.

panels.title: Peer Penalties by Severity /s
panels.description: Rate of peer penalties, by severity and network.

panels.title: Banned Peers
panels.description: Peers the node banned, per network.

panels.title: AddProvider Rate Limit Drops /s
panels.description: Inbound provider announcements dropped before storage because the source exhausted its five-message sliding 60s budget or the retained-window map is full.

panels.title: Kad Provider Write Failures /s
panels.description: Provider database insert failures, such as MDBX capacity or I/O errors. Expected provider-table capacity and input-size rejections are excluded. Original database causes are logged at error level.

panels.title: Firewall drops by rule (packets/s)
panels.description: Packets per second that hit a firewall rule whose nft counter name starts with drop_. The textfile collector reads the named counters every 15 seconds. A counter reset shows as a short gap, not as a negative rate.

panels.title: Firewall accepts by rule (packets/s)
panels.description: Packets per second that hit a firewall rule whose nft counter name starts with accept_. Compare with the drop panel to see the share of rejected traffic.

panels.title: UDP receive buffer errors (per second)
panels.description: Rate of UDP datagrams the kernel dropped because the socket receive buffer was full (Udp and Udp6 RcvbufErrors from the node_exporter netstat collector). A non-zero rate means the node reads slower than the network delivers.

panels.title: UDP rmem_max
panels.description: net.core.rmem_max of the host, as read by the textfile collector. A QUIC socket cannot get a receive buffer above this value.

panels.title: Conntrack occupancy (%)
panels.description: Conntrack table occupancy in percent of nf_conntrack_max. The red line marks the 80 percent alert threshold. The value is meaningful only when the conntrack state is tracked.

panels.title: Collector and conntrack state
panels.description: Explicit states of the host collectors. Collector: exporter-down, collector-absent (no textfile mtime series), collector-stale (file older than 120 seconds), ok. Conntrack: tracked, notrack (a notrack rule is present), unsupported (no conntrack sysctl), collector-failed (the node_exporter conntrack collector returned an error). Absent means Prometheus has no series for that instance.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) ((up{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance"} == 0) + 1) or sum by (instance) ((up{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance"} == 1 unless on (instance) node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",file="tn_host_network.prom"}) + 1) or sum by (instance) (3 * clamp_max(time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",file="tn_host_network.prom"} > 120, 1)) or sum by (instance) (4 * (up{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance"} == 1))

sum by (instance) (8 * (node_scrape_collector_success{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",collector="conntrack"} == 0)) or sum by (instance) (7 * (tn_host_conntrack_mode{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",mode="unsupported"} == 1)) or sum by (instance) (6 * (tn_host_conntrack_mode{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",mode="notrack"} == 1)) or sum by (instance) (5 * (tn_host_conntrack_mode{job=~"$node_job",instance=~"$node_instance",mode="tracked"} == 1))

panels.title: Interface drops and errors (per second)
panels.description: Receive and transmit drops and errors per second for the selected interfaces. Interface counters are per network namespace: the exporter runs in the host namespace and does not see drops inside containers.

panels.title: Committee peers expected vs connected
panels.description: Committee peers the node expects to reach versus the committee peers that have an open connection, per network (primary or worker). The local node is not counted in either value.

panels.title: Committee coverage (%)
panels.description: Connected committee peers as a percentage of expected committee peers. The red line marks two thirds; below it the node cannot see a quorum of the committee. Empty when no committee is loaded.

panels.title: Committee peers missing
panels.description: Expected committee peers minus connected committee peers. Zero is the healthy value.

panels.title: Committee size
panels.description: Number of members in the current committee, including the local node.

panels.title: Connected peers vs committee peers connected
panels.description: All connected peers compared with connected committee peers. A high total with a low committee count means the node has peers, but not the ones consensus needs.

panels.title: Host drops, UDP errors and QUIC incoming outcomes
panels.description: Host firewall drops and UDP receive buffer errors (recording rules) next to QUIC incoming connection outcomes per network. The QUIC series stays empty until PR #1691 merges.

panels.title: Inbound requests pending and shed
panels.description: Inbound requests that wait for a permit, by class, and the rate of requests shed, by class and reason. Growth here together with host drops in the panel on the left points at host pressure, not at the peer.

panels.title: Primary round lag, quorum shortfalls and commit age
panels.description: Distance between the current primary round and the last committed round, the rate of rounds that missed quorum, and the age of the last commit in seconds. The last two series stay empty until PR #1693 merges.

panels.title: Committee membership resolution
panels.description: Committee members the node could not resolve to a peer, the required member count, and the age of the last committee observation in seconds. These series stay empty until PR #1694 merges.

title: Telcoin Node Metrics
